feedback.problem:
Solve the system of equations represented by the augmented matrix 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
The matrix represents a system of three linear equations in three variables, say, $x$, $y$, and $z.$ We obtain the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned} & x+y+3z=-2 \\  & y+4z=0 \\  & z=3\end{aligned}
$$

The third equation states that $z=3.$ Substituting this into the second equation, we get

$$
y+4(3)=0\,⟹\,y=-12.
$$

Now, we substitute $z=3$ and $y=-12$ into the first equation to get

$$
x+(-12)+3(3)=-2\,⟹\,x=-2+12-9=1.
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x=1$, $y=-12$, and $z=3.$ In vector form, the solution can be written as $⟨1,-12,3⟩.$
